aiSummary.title: AI Summary
aiSummary.description: 2-sentence summary: 'Visit at [hospital] with [doctor]. [Drug] discussed, outcome [X], next step [Y].'

engagementScore.title: Engagement Score (0-100)
engagementScore.description: Infer from sentiment: very enthusiastic = 85-95, positive = 65-80, neutral = 45-55, not interested = 20-40, hostile = 5-15.

hospitalName.title: Hospital or Facility Name
hospitalName.description: Hospital name (e.g. 'Apollo Mumbai', 'Tata Memorial'). Improves physician lookup accuracy.

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor's name as spoken (e.g. 'Dr. Sharma'). Resolve by name — never ask for an ID.

transcript.title: Voice Transcript
transcript.description: Full statement from the rep. Include drugs discussed, outcome, follow-ups, anything they mentioned.

visitOutcome.title: Visit Outcome
visitOutcome.description: Exactly one of: Positive, Negative, Neutral, Follow-Up Required. Infer from the rep's words.

visitType.title: Visit Type
visitType.description: Exactly one of: In-Person Clinic, Hospital Round, Virtual Call, Conference / Event, Drop-In. Default = In-Person Clinic.
